title: Clayton Antitrust Act of 1914 — Statute profile
subject: Clayton Antitrust Act of 1914
summary: Clayton Antitrust Act of 1914 is a statute of United States enacted in 1914, in the area of antitrust. Strengthened antitrust law against price discrimination and anti-competitive mergers. It is formally cited as Pub. L. 63-212.
key_points: Core effect: Strengthened antitrust law against price discrimination and anti-competitive mergers.
Status: landmark statute of United States.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
